tips.label: 現在相反假設
tips.text: If + 主詞 + 過去式，主詞 + would/could/might/should + 原形動詞。過去式表示與現在事實相反，不是在說過去。

tips.label: be 動詞
tips.text: 本課正式假設句中，不論主詞是誰，be 動詞都用 were：If I were you, ...

tips.label: 受詞被做某件事
tips.text: have/get + 受詞 + 過去分詞：請人處理某事。make oneself understood/heard：讓自己的意思被理解／聲音被聽見。

notes.title: 與現在事實相反的假設
notes.rule: If + S + 過去式, S + would/could/might/should + V
notes.description: 用來想像與現在事實不同的情況。if 子句用過去式，主要子句用過去式助動詞加原形動詞；would 表示會，could 表示能，might 表示可能，should 較正式且依語意使用。不要在此類 if 子句中用 would 代替過去式。if 子句放前面時以逗號分隔；放後面時通常不用逗號。
examples: If Jason had enough money, he could take a trip to Japan.（如果 Jason 有足夠的錢，他就能去日本旅行；但他現在沒有足夠的錢。）
I would watch the film if I had time.（如果我有時間，我就會看這部電影。）

notes.title: 假設句的 were 與否定
notes.rule: If + S + were / were not ...; If + S + did not + V ...
notes.description: 本課採正式假設語氣：所有人稱的 be 動詞都用 were。一般動詞的否定用 did not 加原形動詞，主要子句的否定則用 would not/could not 等加原形動詞。口語中部分主詞也會搭配 was，但本課練習採 were，題目不把 was 與 were 同列來製造雙解。
examples: If I were you, I would search for a Lan Ren Bao.（如果我是你，我會搜尋懶人包。）
If the plot were not so complicated, I could understand it.（如果情節沒那麼複雜，我就能理解。）
If I did not know the term, I would ask you.（如果我不知道這個用語，我會問你。）

notes.title: 安排他人處理事情
notes.rule: have / get + O + 過去分詞
notes.description: 受詞是動作的承受者，所以受詞後用過去分詞。例如 the computer 接 repaired，因為電腦是被修理的。時態由 have/get 的形式表示，後面的過去分詞不跟著改成原形。不要混淆 have + 人 + 原形動詞（讓某人做）與 have + 物 + 過去分詞（請人處理某物）。
examples: I will have the computer repaired by the technician later today.（今天稍晚我會請技術人員修理電腦。）
She got her hair cut yesterday.（她昨天去剪了頭髮。）

notes.title: 讓自己被理解或被聽見
notes.description: make oneself understood/heard 是常見搭配，表示讓自己的意思被理解或聲音被聽見。這裡是受詞與補語之間有被動關係，整個句子並不是把 make 改成被動語態。make 與 have/get 的語意及搭配不同，不可任意互換所有動詞。
examples: The teacher tried to make himself understood by every student.（老師試著讓每位學生都理解他的意思。）
She spoke loudly to make herself heard.（她大聲說話，讓別人聽見她。）

quiz.question: I do not know this term. If I ___ it, I could explain it.
quiz.hint: 現在不知道，假設知道時 if 子句用過去式 knew。

quiz.question: I have no free time now. If I had time, I would ___ this film.
quiz.hint: would 是助動詞，後面接原形動詞 watch。

quiz.question: If I ___ you, I would check the information again.
quiz.hint: 與現在事實相反的正式假設句，I 後面的 be 動詞用 were。

quiz.question: The plot is difficult. If it ___ simpler, I could understand it.
quiz.hint: 現在情節不簡單，假設相反情況時用 were。

quiz.question: I do not have enough money. If I ___ more money, I could buy a variety of books.
quiz.hint: if 子句描述與現在相反的情況，have 改成過去式 had。

quiz.question: Tom cannot tell the twins apart. If their hats were different, he could ___ them apart.
quiz.hint: could 後面接原形動詞 tell。

quiz.question: I do not need help now. If I ___ help, I would rely on you.
quiz.hint: 想像現在需要幫忙的情況，if 子句用過去式 needed。

quiz.question: The game is complicated. If it were simpler, we ___ enjoy it more.
quiz.hint: if 子句是與現在相反的假設，主要子句用 would 加原形動詞。

quiz.question: There is a misunderstanding now. If he ___ it clearly, we would understand.
quiz.hint: 假設他現在解釋清楚，if 子句用過去式 explained。

quiz.question: I cannot go out now. If I were free, I could ___ up on the news with you.
quiz.hint: could 後接原形動詞 catch。

quiz.question: The amount is too large. If it ___ smaller, I could pay for it.
quiz.hint: 假設現在的金額較小，be 動詞用 were。

quiz.question: I do not know the creator. If I ___ her, I would ask about the film.
quiz.hint: 現在不認識她，if 子句用過去式 knew 表達相反假設。

quiz.question: If I were you, I would not ___ such a risky game.
quiz.hint: would not 後仍用原形動詞 play。

quiz.question: I cannot remember the policy. If I ___ it in mind, I would not make this mistake.
quiz.hint: 假設現在記得規定，if 子句用 keep 的過去式 kept。

quiz.question: We do not have the facts. If we had them, we could ___ a balanced view.
quiz.hint: could 後用原形動詞 give，不用過去式或過去分詞。

quiz.question: She does not live nearby. If she ___ nearby, she would be a frequent visitor.
quiz.hint: 與現在居住情況相反的假設，if 子句用過去式 lived。

quiz.question: The box contains glass cups. If it ___ no glass, I could carry it more easily.
quiz.hint: 假設盒子現在不含玻璃製品，if 子句用過去式 contained。

quiz.question: I cannot understand the report. If I had more time, I might ___ the information.
quiz.hint: might 後面接原形動詞 digest。

quiz.question: I trust this report now. If I ___ a doubt, I would check it again.
quiz.hint: 假設現在有疑慮，if 子句用 have 的過去式 had。

quiz.question: If I were the creator, I ___ not make the plot so complicated.
quiz.hint: 與現在相反的假設，主要子句以 would not 加原形動詞表示不會。

quiz.question: I like this film now. If I did not ___ it, I would choose another one.
quiz.hint: if 子句的否定用 did not 加原形動詞 like。

quiz.question: I do not know your preference. If I ___ it, I could choose a film for you.
quiz.hint: 現在不知道偏好，假設知道時用過去式 knew。

quiz.question: If we ___ so busy now, we could catch up on the news.
quiz.hint: 與現在很忙的事實相反，be 動詞的否定用 were not。

quiz.question: It is risky to go alone. If I were you, I ___ ask a friend to come.
quiz.hint: If I were you 是現在相反假設，主要子句用 would 加原形動詞。

quiz.question: The idea has not crossed his mind. If he thought of it, he could ___ the problem.
quiz.hint: could 後接原形動詞 solve。

quiz.question: The creator had her film ___ at school yesterday.
quiz.hint: film 是被放映的，have 加受詞後接 show 的過去分詞 shown。

quiz.question: I will have my computer ___ by a technician.
quiz.hint: computer 是被修理的，have + O + 過去分詞 repaired。

quiz.question: She got her hair ___ at the shop yesterday.
quiz.hint: hair 是被剪的，get + O 後用過去分詞 cut，其三態同形。

quiz.question: The teacher spoke slowly to make himself ___.
quiz.hint: himself 是被理解的，make oneself understood 用過去分詞。

quiz.question: The room was noisy, so she shouted to make herself ___.
quiz.hint: 她希望聲音被聽見，herself 後用過去分詞 heard。

quiz.question: We had the school policy ___ on the wall.
quiz.hint: policy 是被張貼的，用 have + O + 過去分詞 posted。

quiz.question: The creator got the final scene ___ again.
quiz.hint: scene 是被拍攝的，get + O 後用過去分詞 filmed。

quiz.question: Dad had the broken window ___ this morning.
quiz.hint: window 承受修理動作，受詞補語用過去分詞 fixed。

quiz.question: I will get this report ___ by my teacher.
quiz.hint: report 是被檢查的，get + O + 過去分詞 checked。

quiz.question: She had a variety of cakes ___ to her house.
quiz.hint: cakes 是被送達的，send 的過去分詞是 sent。

quiz.question: Ben used simple terms to make himself ___ by the children.
quiz.hint: 孩子理解 Ben 的意思，himself 與 understand 是被動關係，用 understood。

quiz.question: Please speak louder to make yourself ___.
quiz.hint: make yourself heard 表示讓別人聽見你的聲音，須用過去分詞。

quiz.question: We got the amount on the bill ___ by the waiter.
quiz.hint: amount 是被更正的，get + O 後用過去分詞 corrected。

quiz.question: She had the complicated rule ___ in simple words.
quiz.hint: rule 是被解釋的，have + O 後用過去分詞 explained。

quiz.question: The school will have a new policy ___ for parents.
quiz.hint: policy 是被印出來的，will 不影響受詞後的過去分詞 printed。

quiz.question: I got my bike ___ because riding it was risky.
quiz.hint: bike 是被修理的，get + O 後用過去分詞 repaired。

quiz.question: The creator had a balanced report ___ about the film.
quiz.hint: report 是被撰寫的，用 write 的過去分詞 written，不是過去式 wrote。

quiz.question: We will have the photos ___ by a friend.
quiz.hint: photos 是被拍攝的，用 take 的過去分詞 taken。

quiz.question: She got the old books ___ to the school.
quiz.hint: books 是被送給學校的，用 give 的過去分詞 given。

quiz.question: The teacher used pictures to make her meaning ___.
quiz.hint: meaning 是被理解的，make + O 後用過去分詞 understood。

quiz.question: He raised his voice to make his words ___.
quiz.hint: words 是被聽見的，make + O 後用過去分詞 heard。

quiz.question: I had the important terms ___ into Chinese.
quiz.hint: terms 是被翻譯的，have + O 後用過去分詞 translated。

quiz.question: They got the classroom ___ by the students before the film started.
quiz.hint: classroom 是被打掃的，get + O 後用過去分詞 cleaned。

quiz.question: The creator will have her name ___ to the poster.
quiz.hint: name 是被加到海報上的，have + O 後用過去分詞 added。

quiz.question: We had the broken door ___ by a worker so everyone could enter.
quiz.hint: door 是被打開的，have + O 後用過去分詞 opened。
